zh.title: 美國航空推出OneCabin新機艙清潔計畫 首波於6個樞紐機場實施
zh.summary: 美國航空將於六座樞紐機場推出OneCabin新機艙清潔計畫。
body: 美國航空（American Airlines）預計推行名為「OneCabin」的全新機艙清潔計畫。該項新計畫預計將優先從旗下的六座樞紐機場正式啟動，推動客艙環境與衛生作業流程的調整。
根據 Simple Flying 報導，這項「OneCabin」清潔方案的推出，背景源於美國航空多年以來持續面臨外界對其客艙衛生與維護狀況的批評。
目前該計畫確定將於六個樞紐基地率先實施，美國航空預期透過此項 OneCabin 營運措施，回應長期以來針對機艙內部環境狀況的各項關切。

en.title: American Airlines To Launch OneCabin Cleanliness Program From 6 Hubs
en.summary: American Airlines will launch its new OneCabin onboard cleanliness program starting across six hubs.
body: American Airlines is set to introduce a new onboard cleanliness program called OneCabin, which will initially launch from six of the carrier's operational hubs. The program represents a new onboard operational effort focused on cabin standards.

The announcement comes as American Airlines has faced criticism for years over the condition of its aircraft cabins. The onboard cleanliness program aims to focus on cabin conditions across its primary hub locations.

According to reporting by Simple Flying, the OneCabin initiative will commence across six hubs to address past feedback regarding cabin conditions. The airline's new cleanliness program marks a targeted rollout from key hub facilities.

zh.title: 勞斯萊斯重設單一葉片 提升波音787引擎大修間隔至三倍
zh.summary: 勞斯萊斯重新設計單一發動機葉片；波音787引擎大修時間間隔延長至三倍
body: 根據航空新聞網站 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 8 月 29 日發布的報導，航空發動機製造商勞斯萊斯（Rolls-Royce）已透過對單一發動機葉片進行重新設計，成功將波音 787（Boeing 787）客機發動機的大修間隔時間提升至原先的三倍。
這項針對波音 787 機型發動機葉片的重新設計，大幅延長了發動機在兩次全面大修維護之間的持續運作時間。該報導同時關注這項維修間隔的技術突破，是否代表勞斯萊斯在波音 787 相關發動機市場中迎來營運轉機。

en.title: Rolls-Royce Triples Boeing 787 Engine Overhaul Intervals With Blade Redesign
en.summary: Rolls-Royce triples Boeing 787 engine overhaul intervals following a single blade redesign.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying on August 29, 2026, aircraft engine manufacturer Rolls-Royce has tripled the time between overhauls for engines powering Boeing 787 aircraft. The engine manufacturer achieved this operational maintenance interval extension through a redesign of a single engine blade component.

The redesign of the single engine blade significantly extends the required duration between comprehensive maintenance overhauls for the Boeing 787 powerplant fleet. The report also raised questions regarding whether this technical improvement represents an operational turnaround for Rolls-Royce in the wider Boeing 787 engine market.

zh.title: 聯邦法官嚴詞駁回西南航空結束空服員訴訟請求
zh.summary: 法官駁回西南航空結束訴訟請求；案件涉受保護假期積分扣減
body: 簡報：聯邦法官駁回西南航空（Southwest Airlines）要求結束空服員集體訴訟的動議。法官以嚴厲措辭批評該航空公司錯過關鍵期限，並拒絕其遲遲提出的法律抗辯。此案涉及受保護假期積分被扣減的爭議。
據Simple Flying報導，法官認為西南航空未能在規定期限內回應，導致其駁回訴訟的請求被視為遲遲提出的法律手段。訴訟核心在於航空公司對受保護假期（protected leave）相關積分的扣減政策。

en.title: Federal Judge Rejects Southwest Airlines Bid to End Flight Attendant Lawsuit
en.summary: Federal judge rejects Southwest bid to dismiss flight attendant suit over protected leave points
body: A federal judge has rejected Southwest Airlines' motion to dismiss a flight attendant class-action lawsuit, criticizing the carrier for missing key deadlines. The judge refused what was described as a belated legal maneuver, according to a report by Simple Flying published on August 29.

The lawsuit centers on disputes over point reductions for protected leave. Southwest Airlines had sought to end the litigation, but the court found its filing untimely. The ruling allows the case to proceed, marking a setback for the airline in the ongoing labor dispute.
The decision underscores judicial scrutiny of procedural compliance in labor disputes involving major carriers. Simple Flying noted the judge's unusually strong language in denying the dismissal bid.

zh.title: 曼徹斯特及史坦斯特機場（MAN）母公司稱遭駭客勒索
zh.summary: MAG稱駭客索取贖金遭拒；約870萬人資料受影響
body: 營運曼徹斯特機場（MAN）、倫敦史坦斯特機場（STN）及東密德蘭機場（EMA）的曼徹斯特機場集團（MAG）表示，於2026年8月27日發生的「網路安全事件」中，駭客曾要求支付贖金以換取資料歸還，但該集團拒絕了要求。
MAG指出，駭客存取與停車場、貴賓室及快速通關預訂，以及機場內WiFi註冊相關的「一定數量的客戶資料」，涉及約870萬人的個人資訊，但不包含銀行或付款資料。
據MAG提交給BBC的資料，集團表示已知曉駭客身份並已通報相關當局。MAG強調事件未影響旅客安全或航空安全，也未造成航班營運中斷。

en.title: Manchester Airport (MAN)s Group says hackers demanded ransom in cyber-attack
en.summary: MAG claims ransom was demanded and refused; data of about 8.7 million affected
body: Manchester Airport (MAN)s Group (MAG), which owns Manchester Airport, London Stansted Airport (STN), and East Midlands Airport (EMA), has claimed that hackers demanded a ransom during a "cyber security incident" on August 27, 2026.

According to MAG's statement, hackers accessed a "quantity of customer data" related to car park, lounge, and fast track bookings, and in-airport WIFI sign-ups, affecting approximately 8.7 million individuals across the three airports. On bank or payment details were not accessed.

MAG told the BBC that the demands were refused and that the hackers' identity was used. MAG confirmed that the incident had not resulted in any operational disruption and that passenger safety and aviation security had been compromised.
